Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part, part A, that was stocked at the test location before this release was installed and whose number and description nobody has changed since.
    • How to do it: On this QA site the parts that came with its data and were never changed have no clock icon at the left of their row on the Inventory list; for example 3030 Long Stroke Brake Chamber (W3030LS), which has stock and Min 10 and Max 50, and 3030 Standard Brake Chamber, 13.25" Rod (W3030T). Use W3030LS as part A.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
